data.name: Atman
data.gender_notes: Atman is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ātman, 'self, soul, breath'. Its root is Sanskrit an (अन्). A central concept in Hindu philosophy. Atman is a Sanskrit name meaning “Self; soul; the inner essence”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Atman expresses “Self; soul; the inner essence”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ātman, 'self, soul, breath'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atman total 13, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
